title: Private investment group: guaranteed daily returns
impersonates: a friendly contact running a private investment group
hook: A friendly contact says their private crypto group pays guaranteed daily returns, and the current round closes today.

opening_line.voice: Hello, I got your number from a friend in our private investment group. We pay a guaranteed 3% every day, and there is one place left in today's round.
opening_line.whatsapp: Hi, it's been a while! I joined a private investment group that pays a guaranteed 3% every day, and I saved you a spot in today's round.
opening_line.sms: Hello friend, our private investment group has one place left in today's round with guaranteed daily returns. Reply if you want in before it closes tonight.

stage_goals.PRETEXT: Act as a warm, friendly contact who has made good money in a private investment group, and offer to bring the person in as a favour
stage_goals.PRESSURE: Promise guaranteed daily returns and say the current round closes tonight, so the first deposit must be made today
stage_goals.ASK: Say the first deposit is AED 2,000 in crypto and the payment details will follow, then ask the commit question

commit_question: Are you ready to make your first transfer today before the round closes?
commit_signals: how do i send the crypto
ok i will buy the crypto now

lesson.headline: No real investment guarantees daily profit
three_points: Guaranteed returns do not exist. Anyone promising them is planning to take your money.
A deadline to invest today is pressure, not opportunity. Stop and talk to someone you trust first.
Crypto transfers cannot be reversed. Only invest through licensed firms you have checked yourself.
lesson.report_to: contact the Aman service of Abu Dhabi Police

opening_line.voice: هلا، خذت رقمك من ربيع ويانا في قروب استثمار خاص. القروب يعطي ربح مضمون ٣٪ كل يوم، وباقي مكان واحد في دفعة اليوم.
opening_line.whatsapp: هلا، من زمان عنك! دخلت قروب استثمار خاص يعطي ربح مضمون ٣٪ كل يوم، وحجزت لك مكان في دفعة اليوم.
opening_line.sms: هلا خوي، قروب الاستثمار الخاص عندنا باقي فيه مكان واحد في دفعة اليوم وأرباحه مضمونة كل يوم. رد علي إذا تبا تدخل قبل لا يسكر الليلة.

ar.commit_question: جاهز تحول أول دفعة اليوم قبل لا تسكر الدفعة؟

lesson.headline: ما في استثمار حقيقي يضمن لك ربح كل يوم
three_points: الأرباح المضمونة مب موجودة. أي حد يوعدك فيها يبا ياخذ فلوسك.
مهلة إنك تستثمر اليوم هذا ضغط، مب فرصة. وقف وشاور حد تثق فيه أول.
تحويلات الكريبتو ما ترجع. استثمر بس عن طريق شركات مرخصة إنت متأكد منها بنفسك.
lesson.report_to: تواصل مع خدمة أمان في شرطة أبوظبي
